overview: EduQuiz Manager is a full-stack student management system with admin and student roles. Admins manage subjects, questions, and timers; students take multiple-choice quizzes, earn certificates, and track progress on a live leaderboard.
features: Admin and student logins via Internet Identity
Subject and question management with quiz timers
Student scores and results visible to admin
Student profile with photo, department, register number, enroll number, section
Welcome banner with top score badge, streak counter, and department
Best score badge on each subject card
Streak counter and daily progress tracking
